\section*{Verification scope of the complete chapters}
The continuation retains complete upstream statements and mathematical proofs.
The 433 complete synchronized chapters retain all 1,639 original proofs.
Their 4,667 distinct declaration references comprise 4,424 local
bindings, 241 verified upstream-only bindings and 2 explicitly unresolved historical
attachment names. The unresolved names are not counted as verified.
Local bindings use \texttt{lean} metadata; verified upstream-only facts use
\texttt{upstreamlean}, and unresolved historical names use
\texttt{upstreamunbound}. The current published source revision is
\texttt{0447df8e11b51ada4b90892458bc8008262bf45c} in
\href{https://github.com/MingchenXia/archon-nakamaye}{MingchenXia/archon-nakamaye},
corresponding to the accepted native checkpoint
\texttt{c8830ef1134a201ba69b0f43ff6cbfbea4ba6d1b}.
The per-checkpoint audit reports identify all earlier fixed source revisions
and the complete proof, binding and namespace provenance. The full document
also retains the earlier original extension chapters.
documentation_contexts.after:
\section*{Source and verification scope}
The 482 synchronized chapters preserve the original statements and contain
1,774 nonempty original proof environments. Their 4,974 distinct declaration
reference spellings comprise 4,731 local bindings, 241 upstream-only bindings
and 2 explicitly unresolved historical attachment names. The full document
has 567 chapter inputs, 2,245 nonempty proof environments and 5,890 distinct
local binding spellings. These source counts are separate from compiled Lean
binding checks and the final publication gates recorded in the audit receipts.

The fixed accepted native continuation has 395 chapters, 1,205 labelled nodes,
1,190 complete proof environments and 44 labelled definitions; 15 definitions
have no separate proof environment. Every labelled non-definition in that
native inventory, and in the 59 original chapters recovered by this increment,
has a following complete proof. The recovered chapters include ten older
prerequisite chapters; they do not add ten cases to the native395 count.
The full historical document retains 36 findings from the strict statement-scope
inspector, including five in the synchronized union. These concern historical
label coverage or missing statement proofs and are listed individually in the
audit; no claim that every historical attachment has a complete proof is made.

Local bindings use \texttt{lean} metadata; upstream-only facts use
\texttt{upstreamlean}, and unresolved historical names use
\texttt{upstreamunbound}. The current published source revision is
\texttt{bae7068afc70d624cd8563fd4291436195a7f25f} in
\href{https://github.com/MingchenXia/archon-nakamaye}{MingchenXia/archon-nakamaye},
corresponding to the accepted native checkpoint
\texttt{8230607eccbe39a30d5cdbd252781cfbe48d4dc8}.
The per-checkpoint reports identify earlier fixed source revisions and the
complete source, binding and namespace provenance. The full document also
retains the earlier original extension chapters.
